fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change B: Add ext:schema-notation
fieldValues.proposed_change: Add `ext:schema-notation` as a target-neutral semantic schema IR for spec authoring and target projections.
fieldValues.rationale: The extension boundary separates schema authoring from runtime extraction (`ext:schema`) and from target projections.
